words: these scripts are awful - they make zero sense and have regressed a huge amount. I want the quality of the AI Music or Human Music script (what I actually said on film) to be the floor for all future scripts tonally
dont just file this to the taste ledger, I need harder guarantees than that. this is totally insane after the amount of work we have done together on content

fun.words: remember - every script should be great fun to deliver, and to consume, like the AI Music one was

qualities: a. One story followed from start to end, told in order like a story, never a list of exhibits. A 90-second or short cut has one story thread only: no second example, side-story, named case or second company, not even as a teaser (house rule ONE_STORY_SHORT; Krish, 2026-11-17: "cut curative, one story only is critical for 90 second pieces").
b. Every person, product and term is named and explained in plain words the first time, never anonymised to 'a firm' or 'a brand'.
c. The narrator walks the listener through ('So I've been digging into...', 'this is the bit most people miss'), with his own asides and opinions.
d. Concrete scenes the listener can picture: what you type, what you press, what comes back.
e. A real twist or favourite detail, paid off.
f. A close that reframes the opening question and says what he will do.
g. Every line makes sense heard once with no visuals.
h. Great fun to deliver and to consume, like the AI Music take: lines he enjoys saying out loud, with play, rhythm and jokes, and a listener who is entertained, not lectured.

i. The intro hits the four beats in config/script-floor/intros.json as well as his two reference intros do; a 90-second cut opens with the same four beats compressed, never a different opening. The first sentence is a hook the viewer feels (a surprise, a contradiction or a question about their world), never a flat statement of who pays whom (Krish, 2026-11-17: "When we say \"Anthropic, which makes Claude, pays other companies for customer service\", that does not introduce the piece properly. The first paragraph is just not hooking enough on the 90 sec script").
pass: at or above the floor on every quality
